a: Dome sheyyesh li ben, achshav sheen li ben – nechasay lifloni; haya chole umutal bammitta, veamru lo: nechasav lemi? amar lahen: dome sheishti meubberet, achshav sheen ishti meubberet – nechasay lifloni; venoda sheyyesh lo ben o shehayta ishto meubberet – en mattenato mattana.
Lema rabbi shimon ben menasya hi, vela rabbanan? afillu tema rabbanan, "dome" shane.
Udekaare la – may kaare la? mahu detema: tzareh hu deka madkar, ka mashma lan.
Amar rabbi zera amar rav: minnayin lemattenat shechiv mera shehi min hattora? shenneemar: "vehaavartem et nachalato levitto" – yesh lecha haavara acheret shehi kazo. vee zo? zo mattenat shechiv mera.
Rav nachman amar rabba bar avu, mehacha: "unetattem et nachalato leechav" – yesh lecha netina acheret shehi kazo. vee zo? zo mattenat shechiv mera.

Verav nachman – may tama la amar mivhaavartem"? hahu mibbee leh lechidrabbi – detanya, rabbi omer: bechullan neemra bahen "netina", vechan neemra "haavara"; en lecha shemmaavir nachala mishshevet leshevet, ella bat – hoil uvenah uvalah yorshin otah.
Verabbi zera – may tama la amar miunetattem"? orcheh dikra hu.

Rav menashsheya bar yirmeya amar, mehacha: "bayyamim hahem chala chizkiyyahu lamut, vayyavo elav yeshayahu ven amotz hannavi, vayyomer elav: ko amar Adonai, tzav levetecha, ki met atta velo tichye" – betzavvaa bealma.
Rame bar yechezkel amar, mehacha: "vaachitofel raa ki lo neesta atzato vayyachavosh et hachamor vayyelech el beto el iro vaytzav el beto vayyechanak", betzavvaa bealma.

Tanu rabbanan: shelosha devarim tzivva achitofel et banav – al tihyu bemachloket, veal timredu bemalchut bet david, veyom tov shel atzeret barur – ziru chittim. mar zutera amar: "balul" ittemar. amri nehardae mishshemeh derabbi yaakov: lo "barur" – barur mammash, velo "balul" – balul mammash, ella afillu balul veruach tzefonit menashshavto – ze hu barur.

Amar leh rabbi abba lerav ashe: anan – adderav yitzchak bar avdimi matnenan la, deamar rav yitzchak bar avdimi: motzae yom tov haacharon shel chag, hakkol tzofin laashan hammaaracha; nata kelappe tzafon – aniyyim semechim uvale vattim atzevin, mippene sheggishme shana merubbin, uferot markivin.
Nata kelappe darom – aniyyim atzevim uvale vattim semechin, mippene sheggishme shana muatin, uferot mishtammerin. nata kelappe mizrach – hakkol semechin. kelappe maarav – hakkol atzevin.

Ureminhi: mizrachit – leolam yafa. maaravit – leolam kasha. ruach tzefonit – yafa lechittim beshaa sheheviu shelish, vekasha lezetim beshaa sheyyanetzu. veruach deromit – kasha lechittin beshaa sheheviu shelish, veyafa lezetim beshaa sheyyanetzu.
Veamar rav yosef, veittema mar zutera, veittema rav nachman bar yitzchak: vesimanach – shulchan batztzafon, umenora baddarom. hay merabbe dideh vehay merabbe dideh!
La kashya; ha lan, veha lehu.

Tanya, abba shaul omer: yom tov shel atzeret barur – siman yafe lechol hashshana kullah. amar rav zevid: hay yoma kamma deresh shatta, i chammim – kulla shatta chammima, i karir – kulla shatta karira. lemay nafka minna?
b: Litfillato shel kohen gadol.
Verava amar rav nachman: mattenat shechiv mera midderabbanan bealma hi, shemma tittaref dato alav.

Umi amar rav nachman hachi?! veha amar rav nachman, af al gav deamar shemuel: hammocher shetar chov lachavero, vechazar umechalo – machul; vaafillu yoresh mochel; mode shemuel sheim netano bemattenat shechiv mera, deeno yachol lemochlo.
I amrat bishlama deorayyta, mishshum hachi eno yachol limchol. ella i amrat derabbanan hi, ammay eno yachol limchol? enah shel tora, vaasauha keshel tora.

Amar rava amar rav nachman: shechiv mera sheamar "yadur peloni bevayit ze"; "yochal peloni perot dekel ze" – lo amar kelum, ad sheyyomar: "tenu bayit ze lifloni veyadur bo"; "tenu dekel ze lifloni veyochal perotav".
Lememra desavar rav nachman milleta deita bevari – ita bishchiv mera, deleta bevari – leta bishchiv mera? veha amar rava amar rav nachman:

a: Shechiv mera sheamar "tenu halevaati lifloni" – halevaato lifloni, veaf al gav deleteh bevari! rav pappa amar: hoil veyoresh yorshah.
Rav acha bereh derav ika amar: halevaa ita bevari, vechidrav huna amar rav – deamar rav huna amar rav: "mane li beyadcha, tenehu lifloni"; bemaamad shelashtan – kana.
Ibbaya lehu: dekel leechad uferotav leacher, mahu? mi shayyayr mekom pere, o la shayyayr? im timtze lomar: leacher la have shiyyur; leatzmo – "chutz mipperotav", mahu?

Amar rava amar rav nachman, im timtze lomar: dekel leechad uferotav leacher la have shiyyur mekom pere; dekel leechad veshiyyer perotav lefanav – shayyayr mekom pere. may tama? kol legabbe nafsheh – beayin yafa meshayyer.

Amar leh rabbi abba lerav ashe: anan adderabbi shimon ben lakish matnenan la. deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: hammocher bayit lachavero, veamar lo: "al menat sheddeyota haelyona shelli" – deyota haelyona shello.
b: Ibbaya lehu: bayit leechad udeyota leechad, mahu? mi have shiyyur, o la? im timtza lomar bayit leechad udeyota leechad la have shiyyur, "chutz middeyota", mahu?
Amar rava amar rav nachman: im timtza lomar bayit leechad udeyota leechad la have shiyyur, "chutz middeyota" have shiyyur – veallibba derav zevid, deamar: sheim ratza lehotzi bah zizin – motzi;
Alma kevan deshayyayr deyota – mekom zizin name shayyayr; hacha name, kevan deamar "chutz mipperotav" – mekom pere shayyayr.
Amar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav laacherim – roin; im bimchallek, met – kanu kullan, amad – chozer bechullan.
Im benimlach, met – kanu kullan, amad – eno chozer ella baacharon. vedilma ayyone ka meayyen, vahadar yahev! setameh dishchiv mera middak dayek vahadar yahev.
Amar rav acha bar minyome amar rav nachman: shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav laacherim, veamad – eno chozer, chayyshinan shemma yesh lo nechasim bimdina acheret.
Veella matnitin dekatane: lo shiyyer karka kol shehu – en mattenato kayyemet; hechi mashkachat la? amar rav chama: beomer "kol nechasay". mar bar rav ashe amar: bemuchezak lan delet leh.
Ibbaya lehu: chazara bemiktzat – have chazara bechullah, o la? ta shema: kullan larishon umiktzatan lashsheni – sheni kana, rishon lo kana. may, lav beshemmet?
La, besheamad.

Hachi name mistabbera, middekatane sefa: miktzatan larishon, vechullan lashsheni – rishon kana, sheni lo kana. i amrat bishlama besheamad, mishshum hachi sheni lo kana; ella i amrat beshemmet, tarvayyhu likno!

Amar leh rav yemar lerav ashe: veteheve name besheamad; i amrat bishlama chazara bemiktzat havya chazara bechullah – hayeynu desheni mihat kana. ella i amrat chazara bemiktzat la havya chazara bechullah – nihve kimchallek, ulechad minnayyhu la likno!
Vehilcheta: chazara bemiktzat havya chazara bechullah; resha – mashkachat la ben shemmet ben sheamad, sefa – la mashkachat la ella kesheamed.
Ibbaya lehu: hikdish kol nechasav veamad, mahu? mi amrinan: kol legabbe hekdesh – gamar umakne; o dilma, kol legabbe nafsheh – la gamar umakne?
Hifkir kol nechasav, mahu? mi amrinan: kevan deaf laaniyyim kaashirim – gamar umakne; o dilma, kol legabbe nafsheh la gamar umakne?
Chillek kol nechasav laaniyyim, may? mi amrinan: tzedaka vadday migmar gamar umakne; o dilma, kol legabbe nafsheh la gamar umakne? teku.
Lishshana acharina: hikdish kol nechasav, mahu? hifkir kol nechasav, mahu? chillek kol nechasav laaniyyim, mahu? teku.
Amar rav sheshet: "yittol" veyizke" veyachazik" veyikne" – kullan leshon mattana hen. bematnita tana: af "yachsen" veyerat" – berauy leyorsho, verabbi yochanan ben beroka hi.
Ibbaya lehu:

a: "Yehane bahen", mahi? denehve kullehu mattana kaamar, o dilma lithane minnayyhu midde kaamar? "yerae bahen", mahu? "yaamod bahen", mahu? "yishshaen bahen", mahu? teku.

Ibbaya lehu: machar kol nechasav, mahu? amar rav yehuda amar rav: im amad eno chozer. vezimnin amar rav yehuda amar rav: im amad chozer. vela peligi: ha deitanhu lezuzi beenayyhu, ha defarinhu bechovo.
Ibbaya lehu: shechiv mera shehoda, mahu? ta shema, deissur giyyora hava leh teresar alfe zuze be rava. rav mari bereh – horato shello bikdushsha, veledato bikdushsha havay; uve rav hava.

Amar rava: hechi nikninhu rav mari lehane zuze? i birusha – lav bar yerushsha hu. i bemattana – mattenat shechiv mera kirushsha shavveyuha rabbanan; kol hecha deiteh birusha – iteh bemattana, kol hecha deleteh birusha – leteh bemattana.
I bimshicha – letanhu gabbeh. i bachalifin – en matbea nikne bachalifin. i aggav karka – let leh ara. i bemaamad shelashtan – i shalach li la azelna.

Matkef la rav ika bereh derav amme: ammay? velode issur dehalen zuze derav mari ninhu, velikninhu beodita! addehachi, nefak odita mibbe issur. ikkefad rava, amar: ka magmeri taanata leinashe, umafsedi li.
b: Shiyyer karka kol shehu – mattenato kayyemet. vechamma "kol shehu"? amar rav yehuda amar rav: karka kede farnasato. verav yirmeya bar abba amar: metaltelin kede farnasato.
Amar rabbi zera: kamma mechavvevnan shematata desave; karka tama may – dei kae samech aleh; mittalteli name – i kae samech illavayhu.
Matkef la rav yosef: umay kauonta? man deamar metaltelin – "karka" tenan! man deamar: kede farnasato – "kol shehu" tenan!

Amar leh abbaye: vechol hecha detane "karka" – karka davka? veha tenan: hakkotev kol nechasav leavdo – yatza ben chorin. shiyyer karka kol shehu, lo yatza ben chorin. rabbi shimon omer: leolam hu ben chorin, ad sheyyomar: "kol nechasay netunin lifloni avdi, chutz meechad meribbo shebbahen".

a: Veamar rav dimi bar yosef amar rabbi elazar: asu metaltelin shiyyur etzel eved, velo asu metaltelin shiyyur etzel ketubba!

Hatam bedin hu dela litne karka; veayyeydi ditna resha, rabbi akiva omer: karka kol shehu chayyevet bappea uvabbikkurim, velichtov alehem perozbul, veliknot immahem nechasim sheen lahem achrayut bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka – mishshum hachi katane karka.

Vechol hecha detane "kol shehu" – let leh shiura? veha tenan, rabbi dosa ben harekinas omer: chamesh rechelot gozzot mane mane uferas – chayyayvot bereshit haggez. vachachamim omrim: chamesh rechelot gozzot kol shehen. veamrinan: vechamma "kol shehen"? amar rav: mane uferas, uvilvad sheyyehu mechummashot!
Hatam, bedin hu dela litne "kol shehu"; veayyeyde dekaamar tanna kamma shiura rabba, amar ihu name shiura zutera – kare la "kol shehu".

Peshita – amar: "mittaltelay liflanya" – kol mane tashmishteh kane, levar mechitti useare. "kol mittaltelay liflanya" – afillu chitte useare. vaafillu rechayim haelyona kana, levar merechayim hattachtona. "kol demittaltal" – afillu rechayim hattachtona kane.

Ibbaya lehu: avda – kimkarkea o kemittaltela dame? amar leh rav acha bereh derav avya lerav ashe, ta shema: hammocher et hair – machar battim, shichin, umearot, umerchatzaot, uvet habbaddin, uvet hashshelachin; aval lo et hammittaltelin. uvizman sheamar: "hi vechol ma shebbetochah", afillu hayu bah behema o avadim – hare kullan mechurin. i amrat bishlama kemittaltela dame, mishshum hachi la mizdabban beresha; ella i amrat kimkarkea dame, ammay la mizdabban?

Veella may? kemittaltela dame?! may "afillu"? [ella] may it lach lememar – shane mittaltela denayed mimmittaltela dela nayed; afillu tema kimkarkea dame, shane mekarkea denayed mimmekarkea dela nayed.

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: ta shema, hakkotev leavdo kol nechasav – yatza ben chorin. shiyyer karka kol shehu – lo yatza ben chorin. rabbi shimon omer: leolam hu ben chorin, ad sheyyomar: "kol nechasay netunin lifloni avdi, chutz meechad meribbo shebbahen".

Veamar rav dimi bar yosef amar rabbi elazar: asu mittaltelin shiyyur etzel eved, velo asu mittaltelin shiyyur etzel ketubba. vaamar leh rava lerav nachman: may tama? avda mittaltela hu, umittaltela lemittaltela have shiyyur; uchetubbat ishsha mekarkea hu, umittaltela limkarkea la have shiyyur.
b: Amar leh: anan – mishshum delav kerot gitta matnenan la.
Amar rava amar rav nachman: chamishsha ad sheyyichtevu kol nichsehem; veellu hen: shechiv mera, avdo, ishto, uvanav, mavrachat.
Shechiv mera – ditnan: shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav laacherim, veshiyyer karka kol shehu – mattenato kayyemet; lo shiyyer karka kol shehu – en mattenato kayyemet.
Avdo – ditnan: hakkotev kol nechasav leavdo – yatza ben chorin, shiyyer karka kol shehu – lo yatza ben chorin.
Ishto – deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hakkotev kol nechasav leishto – lo asaah ella appotroppa.
Banav – ditnan: hakkotev kol nechasav levanav, vechatav leishto karka kol shehu – ibbeda ketubbatah.
Mavrachat – deamar mar: mavrachat tzericha shettichtov kol nechaseha.
Uvechullehu mittaltele have shiyyur, levar mikketuva – deammekarkee takkinu rabbanan, mimmittaltele la takkun rabbanan.
Ammemar amar: mittaltele dichtivi bichtubba, veitanhu beenayyhu – have shiyyur.

Amar "nichsay liflanya" – avda ikkeri "nichse", ditnan: hakkotev kol nechasav leavdo – yatza ben chorin. ara ikkeri "nichse", ditnan: nechasim sheyyesh lahen achrayut, niknin bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka. gelima ikkeri "nichse", ditnan: vesheen lahen achrayut – en niknin ella bimshicha.

Zuze ikkeri "nichse", ditnan: vesheen lahen achrayut niknin im nechasim sheyyesh lahen achrayut – bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka. ki ha derav pappa havo leh teresar alfe zuze be chozae, akninhu nihaleh lerav shemuel bar acha aggav assippa deveteh. ki ata, nefak leappeh ad "tevoch".

Shetara ikkeri "nichse", deamar rabba bar yitzchak: shene shetarot hen; amar "zechu besade ze lifloni, vechitvu lo et hashshetar" – chozer bashshetar, veeno chozer bassade. "al menat shettichtevu lo et hashshetar" – chozer ben bashshetar ben bassade.
Verav chiyyay bar avin amar rav huna: shelosha shetarot hen; tere – hane daamaran, iddach – im kadam mocher vechatav et hashshetar, keotah sheshshaninu:

a: Kotvin shetar lammocher veaf al pi sheen lokeach immo; kevan shehechzik ze bakkarka – nikna shetar kol makom shehu. vezo hi sheshshaninu: nechasim sheen lahen achrayut, niknin im hannechasim sheyyesh lahen achrayut – bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka.

Behema ikkeri "nichse", ditnan: hammakdish nechasav vehayta bahen behema reuya legabbe mizbeach; zecharim – olot, unekevot – yimmachru letzorche zivche shelamim. ofot ikkeri "nichse", ditnan: hammakdish nechasav vehayu bahen devarim haruyin legabbe mizbeach – yenot, shemanim veofot.

Tefillin ikkeri "nichse", ditnan: hammakdish nechasav, maalin lo tefillin. ibbaya lehu: sefer tora may? kevan dela mizdabban – deasur lezabboneh – lav nichse hu; o dilma, kevan demizdabban lilmod tora velissa ishsha – nichse hu? teku.
(Siman: zutera, immeh deamram, mittarte achvota, rav tovi verav dimi verav yosef.)

Immeh derav zutera bar toviyya katvinhu lenichsa lerav zutera bar toviyya, devaaya leinnesove leh lerav zevid. innesiva vegarsha. atya lekammeh derav bivi bar abbaye, amar: mishshum innesove – veha innesiva.

Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: mishshum deattu mimmulae, amritu mille muleyayta? afillu leman deamar mavrachat kane, hane mille hecha dela galleya data, aval hacha – galleya data demishshum innesove hu, veha innesiva veiggarsha.

Immeh derame bar chama, beureta ketavtinhu lenichsa lerami bar chama, betzafra ketavtinhu lerav ukeva bar chama. ata rame bar chama lekammeh derav sheshet, okmeh benichse. azal rav ukeva bar chama kammeh derav nachman, okmeh benichse.

Ata rav sheshet lekammeh derav nachman, amar leh: may tama okmeh mar lerav ukeva bar chama? i mishshum dahadara ba – veha shechiva! amar leh, hachi amar shemuel: kol sheillu amad – chozer, chozer bemattenato.
Emor deamar shemuel – leatzmo; leacher mi amar? amar leh, beferush amar shemuel: ben leatzmo ben leacher.

Immeh derav amram chasida hava la meluga dishtarey. ki ka shachva, amra: leheve leamram beri. ato achoha lekammeh derav nachman, amaru leh: veha la meshach! amar lehu: divre shechiv mera kichtuvin vechimsurin damu.

Achateh derav tovi bar rav matna ketavtinhu lenichsa lerav tovi bar rav matna – betzafra. lefanya, ata rav achadvuy bar rav matna becha la – amar la, hasheta amri: mar tzureba merabbanan, umar lav tzureba merabbanan! ketavtinhu nihaleh. ata lekammeh derav nachman, amar leh, hachi amar shemuel: kol sheillu amad chozer, chozer bemattenato.
Achateh derav dimi bar yosef hava la pisketa defardesa, kol emat dahavat chalsha hava makneya leh nihaleh,
b: Vechi kayyma havat hadra bah. zimna chada chalasha, shelacha leh: ta keni. shelach: la baena. shelacha leh: ta keni kol hecha devaet. azal shayyayro ukeno minna. ki kayyma, hadra bah.
Atay lekammeh derav nachman, shelach leh: ta. la ata. amar: may ete? ha shayyayri ukeno minna! shelach leh: i la atet, machena lach besilva dela mabba dema.
Amar lehu lesahadi: hechi hava maase? amaru leh, amara hachi: "vavy deka mayta hach itteta!" amar lehu: im ken, hava metzavve mechamat mita, umetzavve mechamat mita – chozer.

Ittemar: mattenat shechiv mera bemiktzat; amruha rabbanan kammeh derava mishshemeh demar zutera bereh derav nachman deamar mishshemeh derav nachman: hare hi kemattenat bari, vahare hi kemattenat shechiv mera. hare hi kemattenat bari – sheim amad eno chozer, vahare hi kemattenat shechiv mera – dela baaya kinyan.
Amar lehu rava, lav amena lechu: la titlo buke serike berav nachman? hachi amar rav nachman: hare hi kemattenat bari, uvaaya kinyan.

Etiveh rava lerav nachman: shiyyer karka kol shehu – mattenato kayyemet. may, lav dela keno minneh? la, dikno minneh. i hachi, ema sefa: lo shiyyer karka kol shehu – en mattenato kayyemet. vei dikno minneh, ammay en mattenato kayyemet?
Amar leh, hachi amar shemuel: shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav laacherim, af al pi shekkanu miyyado – amad chozer; beyadua shello haya metzavve ella mechamat mita.
Etiveh rav mesharsheya lerava: maase beimman shel bene rochel shehayta chola, veamra: "tinnaten kevinti levitti" – vehiv bishnem asar mane, umeta – vekiyyeymu devareha. hatam bimtzavva mechamat mita.
Etiveh ravina lerava: haomer "tenu get ze leishti, ushetar shichrur ze leavdi", umet – lo yittenu leachar mita. "tenu mane lifloni", umet – yittenu leachar mita.
Umimmay dela keno minneh? dumeya deget – ma get lav bar kinyan, af hay name dela keno minneh! hatam name, bimtzavve mechamat mita.
Rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar: metzavve mechamat mita bealma – baaya kinyan, vechi tanya hane matneyayta – bimchallek kol nechasav, dehahi – mattenat shechiv mera shavveyuha.
Vehilcheta: mattenat shechiv mera bemiktzat – baaya kinyan, veaf al gav demet. metzavve mechamat mita la baaya kinyan, vehu demet; amad – chozer, veaf al gav dikno minneh.

a: Ittemar: mattenat shechiv mera shekkatuv bah kinyan – be rav mishshemeh derav amri: arkeveh attere richshe. ushemuel amar: la yadana may edun ba.

Be rav mishshemeh derav amri: arkeveh attere richshe – hare hi kemattenat bari, hare hi kemattenat shechiv mera; hare hi kemattenat bari – sheim amad eno chozer, hare hi kemattenat shechiv mera – sheim amar halevaato lifloni, halevaato lifloni.
Ushemuel amar: la yadana may edun ba – shemma lo gamar lehakenoto ella bishtar, veen shetar leachar mita.

Uremi derav adderav, vedishmuel addishmuel – dishlach ravin mishshemeh derabbi avahu: hevo yadi sheshshalach rabbi elazar laggola mishshum rabbenu, shechiv mera sheamar: "kitvu utenu mane lifloni", umet – en kotvin venotnin; shemma lo gamar lehakenoto ella bishtar, veen shetar leachar mita. veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel, hilcheta: kotvin venotnin.
Kashya derav adderav, kashya dishmuel addishmuel!
Derav adderav la kashya – ha dikno minneh, ha dela keno minneh. dishmuel addishmuel la kashya – bimyappe et kocho.

Yatev rav nachman bar yitzchak achoreh derava, veyatev rava kammeh derav nachman ka bae minneh – mi amar shemuel: shemma lo gamar lehakenoto ella bishtar, veen shetar leachar mita? veha amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav laacherim, af al pi shekkanu miyyado – amad, chozer;
b: Beyadua shello haya kinyan ella mechamat hammita. veachvi leh bideh, veishtik.
Ki kam, amar rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava: may achvi lach? amar leh: bimyappe et kocho.
Hechi dame meyappe et kocho? amar rav chisda: "ukenena minneh mosif al mattanta da".
Peshita – katav laze vechatav laze, hayeynu dechi ata rav dimi amar: deyayteke mevattelet deyayteke. katav vezikka laze, katav vezikka laze – rav amar: rishon kana, ushemuel amar: sheni kana.
Rav amar: rishon kana – hare hi kemattenat bari. ushemuel amar: sheni kana – hare hi kemattenat shechiv mera.
Veha ippeligu ba chada zimna – bemattenat shechiv mera shekkatuv bah kinyan!

Tzericha; dei ittemar beha – beha kaamar rav, mishshum dikno minneh; aval beha, dela keno minneh – ema mode leh lishmuel. vei ittemar beha – beha kaamar shemuel; aval behach – ema mode leh lerav; tzericha.

Besura – matnu hachi; befumebdita – matnu hachi, amar rav yirmeya bar abba: shelachu leh mibbe rav lishmuel, yelammedenu rabbenu: shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav laacherim, vekanu miyyado, mahu? shelach lehu: en achar kinyan kelum.

a: Sevur minneh, hane mille leacher, aval leatzmo – lo; amar lehu rav chisda: ki ata rav huna mikkuferi, payrsha: ben leatzmo ben laacherim.
Hahu dikno minneh, ata lekammeh derav huna, amar: may ebed lach, dela aknet kidmaknu inashe.
Hahi mattanta dahava katuv bah "bachayyim uvammavet" – rav amar: hare hi kemattenat shechiv mera. ushemuel amar: hare hi kemattenat bari.
Rav amar hare hi kemattenat shechiv mera – middichtiv bah "bammavet", achar mita kaamar leh; vehay dichtiv "bachayyim" – siman bealma, dechaye.
Ushemuel amar hare hi kemattenat bari – middichtiv bah "bachayyim", mechayyim kaamar; vehay dichtav "uvammavet" – keman deamar "meatta vead olam". amri nehardae: hilcheta kevoteh derav.
Amar rava: vei ketiv ba "mechayyim" – kena.
Amar ammemar: let hilcheta kevoteh derava. amar leh rav ashe leammemar: peshita, deha amri nehardae: hilcheta kevoteh derav! mahu detema "mechayyim" – mode rav; ka mashma lan.
Hahu daata lekammeh derav nachman linhardea. shaddereh lekammeh derabbi yirmeya bar abba leshum tamya, amar: hacha atra dishmuel – hechi naaved kevoteh derav!
Hahi daatay lekammeh derava, avad la rava kishmateh. hava ka tarda leh.

Amar leh lerav pappa bereh derav chanan – safreh: zil ketov la, uchetov bah: "socher alehen o matan". amra: litba arbeh! atoye ka matet li! amshinhu lemaneh derava bemayya, vaafillu hachi la ipperak mittiva.

Mishna lo katav bah shechiv mera, hu omer "shechiv mera hayiti", vehen omrim "bari hayita" – tzarich lehavi reaya sheshshechiv mera haya, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: hammotzi mechavero – alav haraya.
Gemara hahu mattanta dahava ketiv ba: "kad hava ketzir ureme bearseh"; vela ketav bah: "umiggo mareh ippetar levet olameh".
b: Amar rabba: hare met, vahare kivro mochiach alav. amar leh abbaye: hasheta, uma sefina – sherubban leaved, notnin alehen chumere chayyim vechumere metim; cholin – sherov cholin lechayyim, lo kol shekken?!
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: keman azla ha shemata derabba – kerabbi natan. detanya: mi motzi miyyad mi? hu motzi midehen belo reaya, vehen en motziin miyyado ella biraya; divre rabbi yaakov.
Rabbi natan omer: im bari hu – alav lehavi reaya shehaya shechiv mera. im shechiv mera hu – alehen lehavi reaya shebbari haya.
Amar rabbi elazar: uletumea – kammachloket. ditnan: bika bimot hachamma – reshut hayyachid lashshabbat, ureshut harabbim lattumea.
Bimot haggeshamim – reshut hayyachid lechan ulechan.
Amar rava: lo shanu ella shello avru alav yemot haggeshamim, aval avru alav yemot haggeshamim – reshut hayyachid lechan ulechan.
Vachachamim omrim: hammotzi mechavero alav haraya vechulei.

a: Reaya – bemay? rav huna amar: reaya beedim. rav chisda verabba bar rav huna amri: reaya bekiyyum hashshetar.
Rav huna amar reaya beedim – ka mippalgi biflugeta derabbi yaakov verabbi natan;
(Siman: manniach.) rabbi meir – kerabbi natan, verabbanan – kerabbi yaakov.

Rav chisda verabba bar rav huna amri reaya bekiyyum hashshetar – ka mippalgi bemode bishtar shekketavo tzarich lekayyeymo; derabbi meir savar: mode bishtar shekketavo – eno tzarich lekayyeymo. verabbanan savri: mode bishtar shekketavo – tzarich lekayyeymo.
Veha ippeligu va chada zimna! detanya: en neemanin lefoslo, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: neemanin!
Tzericha, dei ittemar hahi – behahi kaamri rabbanan, mishshum deallime edim umari shetara; aval hacha – hu delav kol keminneh, ema la;
Vei ittemar beha, beha kaamar rabbi meir; aval behach, ema mode lehu lerabbanan; tzericha.

Vechen amar rabba: reaya beedim. amar leh abbaye: may tama? i nema middechullehu ketiv behu: "kad hava mehallech al raglohi beshuka", uveha la ketiv bah – shema minna shechiv mera have; adderabba! middechullehu ketiv behu: "kad ketzir ureme bearseh", veha la ketiv bah, shema minna bari have!
Ikka lememar hachi veikka lememar hachi, oki mamona bechezkat mareh.
Uviflugeta; derabbi yochanan amar: reaya beedim, verabbi shimon ben lakish amar: reaya bekiyyum hashshetar.

Etiveh rabbi yochanan lerabbi shimon ben lakish: maase bivne verak beechad shemmachar benichse aviv, umet, uvau bene mishpacha veiraru lomar: katan haya bishat mita, uvau veshaalu et rabbi akiva: mahu levodko? amar lahem: i attem rashshaim lenavvevlo. veod, simanin asuyin lehishtannot leachar mita.
b: Bishlama ledidi – deamena reaya beedim; kevan deamar lelakochot: "ayyto edim", vela ashkachu, hayeynu deka ato vaamaru leh: mahu levodko. ella ledidach deamrat: reaya bekiyyum hashshetar, lema lehu levodko? lekayyeymu shetarayyhu, velokmu benichse!
Mi savrat nichse bechezkat bene mishpacha kayymi – veka atu lakochot umearari? nichse bechezkat lakochot kayymi – veka atu bene mishpacha veka mearari!

Hachi name mistabbera, middekaamar lehu: i attem rashshaim lenavvevlo, veishtiku. i amrat bishlama bene mishpacha ka mearari, mishshum hachi ishtiku. ella i amrat lakochot ka mearari, ammay shatki? lemru leh: anan zuze yahavinan leh, linnavavl velinnavvavl!
I mishshum ha – la irya; hachi kaamar lehu: chada, dei attem rashshaim lenavvevlo. veod, vechi temru zuze shekal – linnavavl velinnavvavl; simanim asuyin lehishtannot leachar mita.

Ta shema: shaal rabbi shimon ben lakish et rabbi yochanan, zo sheshshenuya bemishnat bar kappara: hare shehaya ochel sade uva – bechezkat shehi shello, vekara alav echad arar lomar: "shelli hi", vehotzi ze et ono lomar: "shemmechartah li" o "shennetattah li bemattana", im amar: "eni makkir bishtar ze meolam" – yitkayyem hashshetar bechotmav.
Im amar: "shetar passim hu ze" o "shetar amana"; "shemmacharti lach, velo natatta li damim" – im yesh edim, hallech achar edim; veim lav – hallech achar hashshetar.
Lema rabbi meir hi, deamar: mode bishtar shekketavo – eno tzarich lekayyeymo; vela rabbanan?
Amar leh: la; sheani omer: divre hakkol – mode bishtar shekketavo, eno tzarich lekayyeymo. veha miflag peligi! ditnan: en neemanin lefoslo, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: neemanin!
Amar leh: i edim allime umari shetara, ihu kol keminneh?! amar leh, vahalo mishshimcha amru: yafe iraru bene mishpacha! amar leh: zo – elazar amarah; ani lo amarti davar ze meolam.

Amar rabbi zera: im yichpor rabbi yochanan berabbi elazar talmido, yichpor berabbi yannay rabbo? deamar rabbi yannay amar rabbi: mode bishtar shekketavo – eno tzarich lekayyeymo. vaamar leh rabbi yochanan: rabbi, lo mishnatenu hi zo? vachachamim omrim: hammotzi mechavero – alav haraya. en reaya ella bekiyyum hashshetar!

Beram, nirin divre rabbenu yosef – deamar rabbenu yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: zo divre chachamim, aval rabbi meir omer: mode bishtar shekketavo, shetztzarich lekayyeymo. umay divre hakkol? derabbanan legabbe rabbi meir – divre hakkol hi.
Veha ippecha tenan, vachachamim omrim: hammotzi mechavero – alav haraya! efoch. veha tanya: en neemanin lefoslo, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: neemanin! efoch.
Veha rabbi yochanan "reaya beedim" kaamar! efoch. lema lefoch name teyuveta? la,

a: Hachi kaamar leh rabbi yochanan lerabbi shimon ben lakish: bishlama ledidi, deamena: reaya bekiyyum hashshetar – hayeynu demashkachat la denachati lakochot linchasim. ella ledidach deamrat reaya beedim, hechi mashkachat la denachati lakochot binchasim?
Amar leh: modena lach bearar divne mishpacha, delav arar hu. may kaamri? katan haya; chazaka en haedim chotmin al hashshetar, ella im ken naasa gadol.

Ittemar: katan, meematay mocher benichse aviv? rava amar rav nachman: ben shemone esre shana, verav huna bar chinnana amar rav nachman: mibben esrim shana. veha derava – lav beferush ittemar, ella mikkelala ittemar.

Metiv rabbi zera: maase bivne verak beechad shemmachar benichse aviv, umet; uvau bene mishpacha, veiraru lomar: katan haya bishat mita. uvau veshaalu et rabbi akiva: mahu levodko? amar lahem: i attem rashshain lenavvevlo. veod, simanin asuyin lehishtannot leachar mita. bishlama leman deamar ben shemone esre shana,
b: Hayeynu dekaatu veamru leh: mahu levodko. ella i amrat mibben esrim, ki badku leh may have? veha tenan: ben esrim shello hevi shete searot – yaviu reaya shehu ben esrim; vehu hassaris, lo choletz velo meyabbem!
Lav ittemar ala, amar rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak amar rav: vehu shennoldu bo simane saris? amar rava: dayka name, dekatane: vehu hassaris; shema minna.

Vechi la noldu lo simane saris, ad kamma? tane rabbi chiyyay: ad rov shenotav. ki ata lekammeh derabbi chiyyay, i kachesh amar lehu: livre; vei ibberi amar lehu: lichchosh. dehane simane – zimnin deatu mechamat kechishuta, zimnin deatu mechamat beriyyuta.
Ibbaya lehu: toch zeman – kelifne zeman, o kilachar zeman? (amar) rava amar rav nachman: toch zeman kelifne zeman. rava bar rav shela amar rav nachman: toch zeman kilachar zeman.

Veha derava, lav beferush ittemar, ella mikkelala ittemar – dehahu toch zeman deazel zabben nichse, vaata lekammeh derava, amar lehu: lo asa velo chelum. man dachaza savar, mishshum detoch zeman kelifne zeman; vela hi, hatam shetuta yattirta chaza beh – dahava ka meshachrar lehu leavdeh.

Shelach leh giddel bar menashsheya lerava, yelammedenu rabbenu: tinoket bat arba esre shana veyom echad, yodaat betiv massa umattan; mahu? shelach leh: im yodaat betiv massa umattan – mikkachah mikkach umimkarah mimkar.
Velishlach leh tinok! maase shehaya kach haya. velishlach leh tinoket bat shetem esre shana veyom echad! maase shehaya kach haya.

Veha derava, lav beferush ittemar, ella mikkelala ittemar – dehahu pachut mibben esrim daazal zabben nichse avuhu, kegiddel bar menashsheya. ata lekammeh derava, amaru leh keroveh: zil echol tamre, ushedi (beh) kashyayta be rava. avad hachi, amar lehu: zevineh lav zevine.

Ki ka katvu leh shetara, amaru leh lakochot: zil ema leh lerava, megillat ester – bezuza; shetara demar bezuza?! azal amar leh. amar lehu: zevineh zevine. amaru leh keroveh: lakochot agmeruhu! amar lehu: masberi leh – savar. kevan demasberi leh, vesavar – midda yada, vehay daavad hachi – chutzepa yattira hu dahava beh.
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: uleedut – eduto edut. amar mar zutera: la amaran ella lemittaltele, aval limkarkee – la.

Amar leh rav ashe lemar zutera: may shena mittalteli – dizvineh zevine; ella meatta, ha ditnan: happaotot – mikkachan mikkach umimkaran mimkar bemittaltelin, hachi name deedutan edut?! amar leh: hatam, baena "veamdu shene haanashim", velekka.
Amar ammemar: umattenato mattana. amar leh rav ashe leammemar: hasheta, uma zevine – dimkabbel zuze, amrat dela – dilma mozel umezabben; kol shekken mattana – dela mate leh vela midde! amar leh:

a: Uletamaych, zabben shave chamsha – beshitta, hachi name dizvineh zevine?!

Ella kim lehu lerabbanan deyanoka mekarva dateh gabbe zuze; vei amrat zevineh zevine, zimnin dimkarkeshi leh zuze, azel mezabben lechullehu nichse daavu. aval gabbe mattana, i lav dahava leh hanaa minneh – la hava yahev leh mattana; amaru rabbanan: tehve mattenato mattana, delibeydu lehu mille.
Amar rav nachman amar shemuel: bodkin lekiddushin, legerushin, velachalitza, ulemeunin. velimkor benichse aviv – ad sheyyehe ben esrim.
Vechevan divdakna lekiddushin, legerushin lema li? lo nitzrecha ella leyibbum – ditnan: ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto – kenaah. veen noten get ad sheyyigdal.
Lachalitza – leappoke midderabbi yose, deamar: "ish" katuv bapparasha, aval ishsha – ben gedola uven ketanna; ka mashma lan demakkeshinan ishsha leish, dela kerabbi yose.
Ulemeunin – leappoke midderabbi yehuda, deamar: ad sheyyirbe shachor; ka mashma lan dela kerabbi yehuda.
Velimkor benichse aviv ad sheyyehe ben esrim – leappoke mimman deamar ben shemone esre.
Vehilcheta: toch zeman, kelifne zeman. vehilcheta kegiddel bar menashshe.
Vehilcheta kemar zutera. vehilcheta keammemar. vehilcheta kerav nachman amar shemuel – bechullehu.

Mishna hamechallek nechasav al piv, rabbi elazar omer: echad bari veechad mesukkan; nechasim sheyyesh lahen achrayut – niknin bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka, vesheen lahen achrayut – en niknin ella bimshicha.
b: Amru lo: maase beimman shel bene rochel shehayta chola, veamra: "tenu kevinti levitti, vehi bishnem asar mane", umeta, vekiyyeymu et devareha! amar lahen: bene rochel – tikberem imman.

Gemara tanya, amar lahen rabbi eliezer lachachamim: maase bemaroni echad shehaya birushalayim, vehayu lo mittaltelin harebe uvikkesh littenam bemattana. amru lo: en lahem takkana ad sheyyakne al gav karka.

Halach velakach bet sela echad samuch lirushalayim, veamar: tzefono lifloni, veimmo mea tzon umea chaviyyot; uderomo lifloni, veimmo mea tzon umea chaviyyot. vamet, vekiyyeymu chachamim et devarav. amru lo: mishsham reaya?! maroni bari haya.

Amar lahen: bene rochel tikberem imman vechulei. may tama ka layet lehu? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: mekayyeyme kotzim bakkerem hayu, verabbi eliezer letameh – ditnan: hamekayyem kotzim bakkerem, rabbi eliezer omer: kiddesh; vachachamim omrim: lo kiddesh, ella davar shekkamohu mekayyeymin.
Bishlama karkom, chaze; ella kotzim, lemay chaze? amar rabbi chanina: may tama derabbi eliezer? shekken baaravya mekayyeymin kotzim bassadot ligmallehen.
Amar rabbi levi: konin kinyan mishshechiv mera, afillu beshabbat. velo lachosh ledivre rabbi eliezer, ella shemma tittaref dato alav.
Mishna rabbi eliezer omer: bashshabbat – devarav kayyaymin, mippene sheen yachol lichtov; aval lo bachol. rabbi yehoshua omer: bashshabbat amru, kal vachomer bachol.
Kayyotze bo – zachin lakkatan, veen zachin laggadol; divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi yehoshua omer: lakkatan amru, kal vachomer laggadol.
Gemara matnitin manni? rabbi yehuda hi – detanya: rabbi meir omer, rabbi eliezer omer: bachol – devarav kayyaymin, mippene sheyyachol lichtov; aval lo bashshabbat.
Rabbi yehoshua

a: Omer: bachol amru, vekal vachomer lashshabbat. kayyotze bo – zachin laggadol, veen zachin lakkatan; divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi yehoshua omer: begadol amru, kal vachomer lakkatan.

Rabbi yehuda omer, rabbi eliezer omer: bashshabbat – devarav kayyaymin, mippene sheeno yachol lichtov; aval lo bachol. rabbi yehoshua omer: bashshabbat amru, kal vachomer bachol. kayyotze bo – zachin lakkatan veen zachin laggadol, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi yehoshua omer: lakkatan amru, kal vachomer laggadol.

Mishna nafal habbayit alav veal aviv, o alav veal morishav, vehayta alav ketubbat ishsha uvaal chov, yorshe haav omrim: habben met rishon, veachar kach met haav; uvaale hachov omrim: haav met rishon, veachar kach met habben.
Bet shammay omrim: yachloku, uvet hillel omrim: nechasim bechezkatan.
Gemara tenan hatam: hammalve et chavero bishtar – gove minnechasim meshuebadim. al yede edim – gove minnechasim bene chorin.

Bae shemuel: "deikne", vekana; mahu? allibba derabbi meir, deamar: adam makne davar shello ba laolam – la tibbee lach, devadday kana. ella ki tibbee lach – allibba derabbanan, deamri: en adam makne davar shello ba laolam.
Amar rav yosef: ta shema, vachachamim omrim: ze haya pikkeach shemmachar lo et hakkarka, mippene shehu yachol lemashkeno alav!
Amar leh rava: minneh kaamar?! minneh – afillu miggelima deal katpeh! ki ka mibbaya lan, "deikne" – kana umachar, "deikne" – kana vehorish, may?

Amar rav chana, ta shema: nafal habbayit alav veal aviv, alav veal morishav; vehayta alav ketubbat ishsha uvaal chov; yorshe haav omrim: habben met rishon veachar kach met haav, uvaale chovot omrim: haav met rishon kulei.
Vei salka datach "deikne" – kana umachar, "deikne"– kana vehorish, la mishtabed; nehi name deav mayet beresha, "deikne" hu!

Amar lehu rav nachman, zeera chavrin targema: mitzva al hayyetomim lifroa chovat avihen. matkef la rav ashe: milve al pe hu, verav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: milve al pe – eno gove lo min hayyorshin velo min hallakochot!
b: Ella ha manni – rabbi meir hi, deamar: adam makne davar shello ba laolam.
Amar rav yaakov minnehar pekod mishshemeh deravina, ta shema: shitre chov hammukedamin – pesulin, vehameucharin – kesherin.
Vei salka datach "deikne" – kana umachar, "deikne" – kana vehorish, lo mishtabed; meucharin ammay kesherin? "deikne" hu!
Ha manni – rabbi meir hi, deamar: adam makne davar shello ba laolam.

Amar rav mesharsheya mishshemeh derava, ta shema: leshevach karkaot ketzad? hare shemmachar sade lachavero, vehishbichah, uva baal chov uterafah, keshehu gove – gove et hakkeren minnechasin meshuebadin, veet hashshevach minnechasin bene chorin.
Vei salka datach "deikne" – kana umachar, "deikne" – kana vehorish, lo mishtabed; baal chov ammay gove shevacha?
Ha manni – rabbi meir hi, deamar: adam makne davar shello ba laolam.

Im timtza lomar: "deikne" – kana umachar, "deikne" – kana vehorish, lo mishtabed; ha lo mishtabed. im timtza lomar: mishtabed; lava velava, vechazar vekana, mahu? lekamma mishtabad, o levatra mishtabad?

Amar rav nachman: ha milleta ibbaya lan, ushelachu mittam: rishon kana. rav huna amar: yachloku. vechen tane rabba bar avu: yachloku. amar ravina: mahdura kamma derav ashe, amar lan: rishon kana. mahdura batra derav ashe, amar lan: yachloku. vehilcheta: yachloku.

Metivi: leshevach karkaot ketzad? hare shemmachar sade lachavero vehishbichah, uva baal chov uterafah, keshehu gove – gove et hakkeren minnechasin meshuebadin, veet hashshevach minnechasin bene chorin. veim ita, chatzi shevach mibbee leh!
May "gove" name dekatane – chatzi shevach.

a: Mishna nafal habbayit alav veal ishto, yorshe habbaal omrim: ishsha meta rishon, veachar kach met habbaal; yorshe ishsha omrim: baal met rishon, veachar kach meta ishsha –
Bet shammay omrim: yachloku. uvet hillel omrim: nechasim – bechezkatan, ketubba – bechezkat yorshe habbaal, nechasim hannichnasin vehayyotzin immah – bechezkat yorshe haav.
b: Gemara bechezkat mi? rabbi yochanan amar: bechezkat yorshe habbaal, verabbi elazar amar: bechezkat yorshe haishsha,
Verabbi shimon ben lakish mishshum bar kappara amar: yachloku. vechen tane bar kappara: hoil vehallalu bain lirash vehallalu bain lirash, yachloku.

Mishna nafal habbayit alav veal immo, ellu vaellu modin sheyyachloku. amar rabbi akiva: mode ani bazo, shehannechasim bechezkatan. amar lo ben azzay: al [ha]chalukin anu mitztaarin; ella shebbata lechallek alenu et hashshavin?!

Gemara bechezkat mi? rabbi ila amar: bechezkat yorshe haem. rabbi zera amar: bechezkat yorshe habben. ki salek rabbi zera, kam beshitteh derabbi ila. kam rabba beshitteh derabbi zera. amar rabbi zera, shema minna – avvera deeretz yisrael machkim.
Vetama may? amar abbaye: hoil vehuchezka nachala beoto shevet.
Amar lo ben azzay: al hachalukin anu mitztaarin vechulei. amar rabbi simlay, ada amra – ben azzay talmid chaver derabbi akiva hava, dekaamar leh "shebbata".

Shelachu mittam: ben shellava benichse aviv bechayye aviv, vamet – beno motzi miyyad hallakochot. vezo hi shekkasha bedine mamonot. lava – may mappek? veod, lakochot may avidteh? ella i ittemar, hachi

a: Ittemar: ben shemmachar benichse aviv bechayye aviv, vamet – beno motzi miyyad hallakochot. vezo hi shekkasha bedine mamonot – velemru leh: avuch mezabben, veat mappek?!
Umay kusheya? dilma matze amar: mikkoach avu deabba kaatena – tidda, dichtiv: "tachat avotecha yihyu vanecha, teshitemo lesarim bechol haaretz"!

Ella i kashya, ha kashya – ben bechor shemmachar chelek bechora bechayye aviv, vamet bechayye aviv – beno motzi miyyad hallakochot. vezo hi shekkasha bedine mamonot – avu mezabben, ihu mappek?! vechi tema, hacha name amar: mikkoach avu deabba kaatena; i mikkoach avu deabba ka atya, bechelek bechora may avidteh?
Umay kusheya? dilma matze amar: mikkoach avu deabba kaatena – uvimkom av kaemna!

Ella i kashya, ha kashya – haya yodea lo edut bishtar ad shello naasa gazlan, venaasa gazlan – hu eno meid al ketav yado, aval acherim meidin. hasheta ihu la meheman, achrine mehemni?! vezo hi shekkasha bedine mamonot.
May kusheya? dilma kegon shehuchezak ketav yado bevet din!

Ella i kashya, ha kashya – haya yodea lo edut bishtar ad shello tippol lo birushsha; hu eno yachol lekayyem ketav yado, aval acherim yecholin lekayyem ketav yado. umay kusheya? dilma hacha name, kegon shehuchezak ketav yado bevet din!
Ella i kashya, ha kashya – haya yodea lo beedut ad shello naasa chatano, venaasa chatano – hu eno meid al ketav yado, aval acherim meidin. hu la meheman, achrine mehemni?!
Vechi tema hacha name – kegon shehuchezak ketav yado bevet din, veha amar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: af al pi shello huchezak ketav yado bevet din!

Umay kusheya? dilma gezerat melech hi, deihu la meheman, veachrine mehemni – velav mishshum dimshakkar! dei la tema hachi, moshe veaharon lechotnam – mishshum dela mehemni hu?! ella gezerat melech hu shello yaidu lahem, hacha name – gezerat melech hu shello yaid al ketav yado lechotno!
Ella leolam kidamrinan meikkara, udeka kashya lach "tachat avotecha yihyu vanecha" – hahu bivracha ketiv.
Umi matzet amrat bivracha ketiv –
b: Aval leinyan dina la?!

Vehatanya: nafal habbayit alav veal aviv, alav veal morishav; vehayta alav ketubbat ishsha uvaal chov; yorshe haav omrim: habben met rishon, veachar kach met haav; uvaal chov omer: haav met rishon, veachar kach met habben.

May, lav "yorshe haav" – bene, "morishav" – ache? vei salka datach la matze amar "mikkoach avu deabba kaatena", dechi ketiv: "tachat avotecha yihyu vanecha" – bivracha ketiv; ki met habben veachar kach met haav – may have? nema lehu baal chov: yerushshat avuhon ka shakelna!
La; "yorshe haav" – echav, "morishav" – ache daavu.

Beo minneh merav sheshet: ben, mahu sheyyirash et immo bakkever – lehanechil laachin min haav? amar lehu rav sheshet, tenetuha: haav shennishba, umet beno bammedina; uven shennishba, umet aviv bammedina – yorshe haav veyorshe habben yachloku.

Hechi dame? illema kidkatane, he ninhu yorshe haav vehe ninhu yorshe habben? ella lav hachi kaamar: av shennishba umet ben bitto bammedina, uven bitto shennishba umet avi immo bammedina, vela yadinan he minnayyhu mit beresha – yorshe haav veyorshe habben yachloku.
Veim ita, nehi name deven met beresha, lerteh laavu deimmeh bekivreh, velertinhu laachoah min avu! ella lav shema minna – en habben yoresh et immo bakkever, lehanechil laachin meav?

Amar leh rav acha bar minyome leabbaye, af anan name tenena: nafal habbayit alav veal immo – ellu vaellu modim sheyyachloku. veim ita, nehi name deven met beresha, lertay leimmeh bekivreh, velertu inhu leache meavu! ella lav shema minna en habben yoresh et immo bakkever lehanechil laachin min haav? shema minna.

Vetama may? amar abbaye: neemra "sibba" babben, veneemra "sibba" babbaal; ma "sibba" haamura babbaal – en habbaal yoresh et ishto bakkever, af "sibba" haamura babben – en habben yoresh et immo bakkever, lehanechil laachin min haav.
Hahu daamar leh lechavreh: nichse devar sisin mezabbenyna lach. havay chada ara dahava mikkarya "deve bar sisin", amar leh: ha lav deve bar sisin hi, veikkeroye hu demikkarya "deve bar sisin".
Ata lekammeh derav nachman, okma bida delokeach. amar leh rava lerav nachman: dina hachi?! hammotzi mechavero – alav haraya! verame derava adderava, uderav nachman adderav nachman –
Dehahu daamar leh lechavreh: may baet behay beta? amar leh: minnach zeventa, vaachalit shene chazaka. amar leh: ana beshikkune gavvae havay.
Ata lekammeh derav nachman, amar leh: zil beror achilatach. amar leh rava lerav nachman: dina hachi?! hammotzi mechavero – alav haraya! kashya derava adderava, uderav nachman adderav nachman!
Derava adderava la kashya – hacha mocher kae benichseh, hatam lokeach kae benichseh.

Derav nachman adderav nachman la kashya – hacha, kevan deamar leh: deve bar sisin, umikkarya "deve bar sisin"; aleh dideh ramya legalloye delav deve bar sisin hi. hacha, lo yehe ella denaket shetara – mi la amrinan leh: kayyem shetarach vekum benichse?
Hadaran alach mi shemmet

a: Get pashut – edav mittocho. mekushshar – edav meachorav.

Pashut – shekkatvu edav meachorav, mekushshar – shekkatvu edav mittocho, shenehem pesulin. rabbi chanina ben gamliel omer: mekushshar shekkatvu edav mittocho – kasher, mippene sheyyachol laasoto pashut. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hakkol keminhag hammedina.
Get pashut – edav bishnayim, umekushshar – bishlosha. pashut shekkatav bo ed echad, umekushshar shekkatav bo shene edim – shenehem pesulin.
Gemara menahane mille? amar rabbi chanina, deamar kera: "sadot bakkesef yiknu, vechatov bassefer vechatom, vehaed edim". "sadot bakkesef yiknu vechatov bassefer" –
b: Ze pashut. "vechatom" – ze mekushshar. "vehaed" – shenayim, "edim" – shelosha. ha ketzad? shenayim lefashut, shelosha limkushshar.
Veefoch ana! mittoch shennitrabba biksharav, nitrabba beedav.

Rafram amar, mehacha: "vaekkach et sefer hammikna, et hechatum hammitzva vehachukkim, veet haggaluy"; "vaekkach et sefer hammikna" – ze pashut. "et hechatum" – ze mekushshar. "veet haggaluy" – ze pashut shebbamkushshar.
"Hammitzva vehachukkim" – ellu devarim shebben pashut limkushshar. ha ketzad? ze edav shenayim, veze edav shelosha; ze edav mittocho, veze edav meachorav.
Veefoch ana! mittoch shennitrabba biksharav, nitrabba beedav.

Rame bar yechezkel amar, mehacha: "al pi shenayim edim o al pi shelosha edim yakum davar" – im titkayyem edutan bishnayim, lamma parat lach bishlosha? lomar lach: shenayim lefashut, shelosha limkushshar.
Veefoch ana! mittoch shennitrabba biksharav, nitrabba beedav.

Vehane lehachi hu deatu? kol chad vechad lemilleteh hu daata – lechidtanya: "sadot bakkesef yiknu, vechatov bassefer vechatom" – etza tova ka mashma lan. "vaekkach et sefer hammikna" – hachi hava maase. "al pi shenayim edim o al pi shelosha edim" – lehakkish shelosha lishnayim, biflugeta derabbi akiva verabbanan!
Ella mekushshar midderabbanan, ukerae asmachta bealma.
Vetama may takkinu rabbanan mekushshar? atra dechahane havo, vahavo kafdi tuva umegarshi nashayyhu; veavdi rabbanan takkanta, addehachi vehachi miyyatteva datayyhu.
Hatinach gittin, shetarot may ikka lememar? kede shello techallek ben gittin lishtarot.
Hechan edim chotmin? rav huna amar: ben kesher lekesher. verav yirmeya bar abba amar: achore hakketav – ucheneged hakketav mibbachutz.

Amar leh rame bar chama lerav chisda: lerav huna deamar ben kesher lekesher – ka salka datin ben kesher lekesher miggavvay – veha hahu mekushshar daata lekammeh derabbi, veamar rabbi: en zeman baze! amar leh rabbi shimon berabbi lerabbi: shemma ben kesharav muvela? palyeh, vechazyeh. veim ita, "en zeman baze veen edim baze" mibbaya leh!
Amar leh: mi savrat ben kesher lekesher – miggavvay? la, ben kesher lekesher – meabbaray.
Venechush dilma zayyef vechatev may devae, vachatimi sahadi!
Dichtiv beh: "sharir vekayyaym".
Venechush dilma katev may devae, vahadar katev "sharir vekayyaym" acharina! chad "sharir vekayyaym" katvinan, tere "sharir vekayyaym" la katvinan.
Velechush dilma machek leh lesharir vekayyaym", vechatav may devae, vahadar katev "sharir vekayyaym"! ha amar rabbi yochanan: teluya; mekuyyemet – keshera,

a: Mechak – pasul, veaf al pi shemmekuyyam.
Velo amru mechak pasul – ella bimkom "sharir vekayyaym", ucheshiur "sharir vekayyaym".
Ulerav yirmeya bar abba, deamar: achore hakketav – ucheneged hakketav mibbachutz; lechush dilma katev miggavvay may devae, umachtim sahade yattire meabbaray, veamar: ana lerabbot beedim hu daavadi!
Amar leh: mi savrat edim kesidran chatimi? edim mimmatta lemala chatimi.
Velechush dilma mitramya reuta beshita acharona, vegayez lay leshita acharona – vegayez leh liruven bahadeh, umittachshar beven yaakov ed"; ditnan: "ben ish peloni, ed" – kasher!
Dichtiv "reuven ben" bechad dara, veyaakov ed" illavevy.
Velichosh dilma gayez leh liruven ben", umittachshar beyaakov ed" – ditnan: "ish peloni ed", kasher!
Dela ketiv "ed".
Veibbaet ema: leolam dichtiv "ed", deyadinan ba deha chatimut yeda –
b: Lav deyaakov hu.
Vedilma bishmeh daavu chatam! la shavek inish shemeh dideh, vechatem bishmeh daavu.

Vedilma simana bealma hu deshavvevye! deha rav tzayer kevora, rabbi chanina tzayer charuta, rav chisda samech, rav hoshaya – ayin, rava bar rav huna – machuta! la chatzif inash leshauoye lishmeh daavu simana.
Mar zutera amar: lema lach kulle hay? kol mekushshar sheen edav kalin beshita achat – pasul.
Amar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan: kol hammechakin kullan, tzarich sheyyichtov "veden kiyyumehon". vetzarich sheyyachazor meinyano shel shetar beshita acharona; may tama?

a: Amar rav amram: lefi sheen lemedin mishshita acharona.
Amar leh rav nachman lerav amram: mena lach ha? amar leh, detanya: hirchik et haedim shene shitin min hakketav – pasul, shita achat – kasher.
May shena shene shitin – dilma mezayyef vechatev; shita achat name, mezayyef vechatav! ella lav shema minna en lemedin mishshita acharona? shema minna.
b: Ibbaya lehu: shita umechetza, may? ta shema: hirchik et haedim shene shitin – pasul. ha shita umechetza – kasher.
Ema sefa: shita achat – kasher. shita achat hu dechasher, ha shita umechetza – pasul! ella meha lekka lemishma minna.
May have ala? ta shema, detanya: hirchik et haedim shene shitin min hakketav – pasul. pachot mikkan – kasher.
Hayu arbaa vachamishsha edim chatumin al hashshetar, venimtza echad mehen karov o pasul – titkayyem edut bashshear.
Mesayyay leh lechizkiyya, deamar chizkiyya: milleahu bikrovim – kasher.
Veal titma, shehare avir sukka posel bishlosha, sechach pasul posel bearbaa.
Ibbaya lehu: shene shitin sheamru –

a: Hen vaaviran, o dilma hen velo aviran?
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: mistabbera dehen vaaviran, dei salka datach hen velo aviran – shita achat belo avirah, lemay chazya? ella shema minna – hen vaaviran! shema minna.
Rabbi shabbetay amar mishshemeh dechizkiyya: shene shitin sheamru – bichtav yede edim, velo ketav yede sofer. may tama? dechol hamezayyef, lav legabbe safra azel umezayyef.
Vechamma? amar rav yitzchak ben elazar: kegon "lecha–lecha" ze al gabbe ze. alma kasavar: shene shitin, vearbaa avirin.
Rav chiyyay bar amme mishshemeh deulla amar: kegon lamed millemala vechaf millematta. alma kasavar: shene shitin ushelosha avirin.
Rabbi avahu amar: kegon: "baruch ben levi" beshita achat. ka savar: shita achat ushene avirin.
Amar rav: lo shanu ella ben edim lakketav, aval ben edim laashsharta – afillu tuva name kasher.
May shena ben edim lakketav – dilma mezayyef vechatev may devae, vachatimi sahadi; ben edim laashsharta name, mezayyef vechatev may devae, vachatimi sahadi!
Dimtayyet leh. i hachi, ben edim lashshetar name metayyet leh!
Amri: sahade atteyuta hu dachatimi. ben edim laashsharta name, amri: be dina atteyuta hu dachatimi! be dina atteyuta la chatimi.
Velechush dilma gayez leh leella, umachek leh lityuta, vechatev may devae, umachtim sahade; veamar rav: shetar habba hu veedav al hammechak – kasher!
b: Hanicha lerav kahana – dematne la mishshemeh dishmuel, shappir; ella lerav tavyome – dematne la mishshemeh derav, may ikka lememar?
Kasavar: kol ki hay gavvna, en mekayyeymin oto min haashsharta shebbo, ella min haedim shebbo.
Verabbi yochanan amar: lo shanu ella ben haedim lakketav, aval ben edim laashsharta – afillu shita achat pasul.
May shena ben edim laashsharta – dilma gayez leillay, vechatev hu veedav beshita achat, vekasavar: shetar habba hu veedav beshita achat – kasher;
I hachi, ben edim lakketav name – dilma gayez leh leillay, vechatev may devae, vachatimi sahade! ka savar: shetar habba hu beshita achat, veedav beshita acheret – pasul.
Velechush dilma katev hu veedav beshita achat, veamar: ana lerabbot beedim hu daavadi!
Kasavar: kol ki hay gavvna – en mekayyeymin oto min haedim shellematta, ella min haedim shellemala.
Gufa – amar rav: shetar habba hu veedav al hammechak – kasher.

a: Veim tomar: mochek vechozer umochek! eno dome nimchak paam achat, lenimchak shete feamim.
Velechush dilma shade deyota ammekom edim meikkara, umachek leh – dechi hadar machek leh lehay, have leh idde veidde nimchak shete feamim!
Amar abbaye, kasavar rav: en haedim chotmin al hammechak, ella im ken nimchak bifnehem.
Metivi: hu al hanneyayr veedav al hammechak – kasher. venechush dilma machek leh, vechatev may devae, vehave leh hu veedav al hammechak!
Dechatvi hachi: "anachna sahade – chatamna al mechaka, ushetara – ketiv al neyayra".
Dechatvi hecha? i milletachat – gayez leh; i illay – machek leh! dechatvi ben sahada lesahada.
I hachi, ema sefa: hu al hammechak, veedav al hanneyayr – pasul. ammay pasul? hacha name, nichtevu hachi: "anachna sahade – chatamna al neyayra, ushetara – al mechaka"!

[Hasheta name] may amrat – mochek chozer umochek? ha amrat: eno dome nimchak paam achat, lenimchak shete feamim! hane mille – hecha dachatimi sahade ammechaka; hecha dela chatimi sahade ammechaka ella anneyayra – la yedia.
Velayte megilleta achariti, velimchok velidamme! la dame mechaka deha megilleta, limchaka deha megilleta.
Ulekabbela lachatimut yeda desahadi beve dina, velimchok velidamme! amar rav hoshaya: eno dome nimchak ben yomo, lenimchak ben shene yamim.
Velishahayeh! amar rabbi yirmeya: chayyshinan levet din toin.
Rabbi chanina ben gamliel omer: mekushshar vechulei. heshiv rabbi ledivre rabbi chanina ben gamliel:
b: Vahalo eno dome zemanno shel ze lizmanno shel ze! pashut; malach shana – monin lo shana, shetayim – monin lo shetayim. mekushshar; malach shana – monin lo shetayim, shetayim – monin lo shalosh.
Vezimnin deyazef minneh zuze bimkushshar, umitreme leh zuze bene bene ufara leh; veamar leh: hav li shetaray, veamar leh: irchas li; vechatev leh tevara;
Vechi mate zimneh, meshavve leh pashut, veamar leh: hane hasheta dizaft minnay!
Ka savar: en kotvin shovar.

Umi baki rabbi bimkushshar? veha hahu mekushshar daata lekammeh derabbi, veamar rabbi: shetar meuchar ze! veamar lo zunin lerabbi: kach minhagah shel umma zo; malach shana – monin lo shetayim, shetayim – monin lo shalosh!
Batar deshama mizzunin, savra.
Hahu shetara dahava ketiv beh: "bishnat peloni archan". amar rabbi chanina: yivdok ematay amad archan bearchanuteh.
Vedilma daarich malchuteh! amar rav hoshaya: kach minhagah shel umma zo; shana rishona – korin lo "archan", sheniyya – korin lo digon.
Vedilma abbore abberuhu, vahadar okmuhu! amar rabbi yirmeya: hahu "archan digon" karu leh.
Tanu rabbanan: "hareni nazir hena" – somchos amar: "hena" – achat. "digon" – shetayim. "terigon" – shalosh. "tetrigon" – arba. "pentigon" – chamesh.
Tanu rabbanan: bayit agol; digon; terigon; pentigon – eno mittamme bingaim. tetrigon – mittamme bingaim.
Mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan, lemala omer: "kir–kirot" – shetayim; lematta omer: "kir–kirot" – shetayim; hare kan arba.

Hahu mekushshar daata lekammeh derabbi, veamar rabbi: en zeman bazze?! amar leh rabbi shimon bar rabbi lerabbi: shemma ben kesharav muvela? palyeh, vechazyeh. hadar chaza beh rabbi bevishut. amar leh: lav ana ketavteh, rabbi yehuda chayyayta katveh. amar leh: kelach millashon hara hazze.
Zimnin hava yatev kammeh, veka fasek sidra besefer tehillim; amar rabbi: kamma meyushshar ketav ze! amar leh: lav ana ketavteh, yehuda chayyayta katveh. amar leh: kelach millashon hara hazze.

Bishlama hatam, ikka lashon hara; ella hacha, may lashon hara ikka? mishshum derav dimi – detane rav dimi achu derav safra: leolam al yesapper adam betovato shel chavero, shemmittoch tovato ba lide raato.
Amar rav amram amar rav: shalosh averot en adam nitztzol mehen bechol yom – hirhur avera, veiyyun tefilla, velashon hara. lashon hara salka datach?!

a: Ella avak lashon hara.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: rov begazel, umiut baarayot, vehakkol belashon hara. belashon hara salka datach?! ella avak lashon hara.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hakkol keminhag hammedina. vetanna kamma let leh minhag medina?
Amar rav ashe: beatra dinhigi pashut, vaamar leh: "aved li pashut", vaazal avad leh mekushshar – kefeda. nehigi mekushshar, vaamar leh: "aved li mekushshar", vaazal avad leh pashut – kefeda.
Ki peligi – beatra dinhigi befashut umekushshar, vaamar leh: "aved li pashut", vaazal avad leh mekushshar; mar savar: kefeda, umar savar: mare makom hu lo.
Amar abbaye: rabban shimon ben gamliel verabbi shimon verabbi elazar – kullehu sevira lehu: mare makom hu lo.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel – ha daamaran. rabbi shimon – ditnan,
Rabbi shimon omer: im hitah leshevach, hare zo mekuddeshet.
Rabbi elazar – ditnan, haishsha sheamra: "hitkabbel li gitti mimmakom peloni", vekibbelo lah mimmakom acher – pasul; verabbi elazar machshir. mar savar: kefeda, umar savar: mare makom hu lo.

[Pashut shekkatuv bo ed echad kulei] bishlama mekushshar shekkatuv bo shene edim, pasul – itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil uvealma kasher – hacha name kasher; ka mashma lan defasul. ella pashut shekkatuv bo ed echad – peshita!
Amar abbaye: la nitzrecha – daafillu ed echad bichtav, veed echad befe.
Ammemar achshar beed echad bichtav veed echad al pe. amar leh rav ashe leammemar: veha deabbaye, may? amar leh: la shemia li – kelomar, la sevira li.
Ella kashya
b: Matnitin!
Ha ka mashma lan – dishnayim bimkushshar, keed echad befashut; ma hatam – pesula deorayyta, af hacha name – pesula deorayyta.
Tidda, dishlachu mittam chavrayyay lerabbi yirmeya:
Ed echad bichtav veed echad al pe, mahu sheyyitztarfu?

Allibba detanna kamma derabbi yehoshua ben korcha – la tibbee lach, daafillu shenayim bichtav ushenayim al pe la mitztarfi. ella ki tibbee lach, allibba derabbi yehoshua ben korcha – shenayim bichtav ushenayim al pe hu demitztarfi, aval ed echad bichtav veechad al pe la metzarfinan; o dilma la shena?
Shelach lehu: ani eni kedayy sheshshelachtem li, ella kach daat talmidchem nota – sheyyitztarfu.
Amar leh: anan hachi matnenan lah – dishlachu leh chavrayyay lerabbi yirmeya: shenayim sheheidu – echad bevet din ze, veechad bevet din ze; mahu sheyyavou bet din etzel bet din, veyitztarfu?

Allibba detanna kamma derabbi natan la tibbee lach – daafillu bechad bet dina name la mitztarfi; ella ki tibbee lach allibba derabbi natan – bechad be dina hu demitztarfi, aval bitre be dina la mitztarfi; o dilma la shena?
Ushelach lehu: ani – eni kedayy sheattem shelachtem li, ella kach daat talmidchem note – sheyyitztarfu.
Mar bar chiyyay amar, hachi shelachu leh: shenayim sheheidu bevet din ze, vechazru veheidu bevet din ze – mahu sheyyavo echad mikkol bet din veyitztarfu?

Allibba derabbi natan la tibbee lach – hasheta edim metzarfinan, dayyayne mibbaya? ella ki tibbee lach, allibba detanna kamma derabbi natan – edim hu dela metzarfinan, aval dayyayne metzarfinan; o dilma la shena?
Shelach lehu: ani – eni kedayy sheattem shelachtem li, ella kach daat talmidchem note – sheyyitztarfu.
Ravina amar, hachi shelachu leh: shelosha sheyyashvu lekayyem et hashshetar, umet echad mehen; tzerichi lemichtav "bemotav telata havena, vechad letohi", o la?
Shelach lehu: ani – eni kedayy sheattem shelachtem li, ella kach daat talmidchem note – shetztzerichin lemichtav: "bemotav telata havena, vechad letohi".
Veal da ayyeyluhu lerabbi yirmeya beve midresha.
Mishna katuv bo: "zuzin mea, deinnun silin esrin" – en lo ella esrin. "zuzin mea, deinnun telatin silin" – en lo ella mane.
"Kesaf zuzin deinnun", venimchak – en pachot mishshetayim. "kesaf silin deinnun", venimchak – en pachot mishshetayim. "darkonot deinnun", venimchak – en pachot mishshetayim.

Katuv bo millemala mane umillematta matayim; millemala matayim umillematta mane – hakkol holech achar hattachton. im ken, lama kotvin et haelyon? sheim timmachek ot achat min hattachton – yilmad min haelyon.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: amar "kesef" – en pachot middinar kesef. "kesef dinarin" vedinarin kesef" – en pachot mishshene dinarin kesef. "kesef bedinarin" – en pachot mibbishne dinarin dehav, kesef.
Amar mar: "kesef" – en pachot middinar kesef. veema nesacha! amar rabbi elazar: dechatuv beh "matbea". veema perite! amar rav pappa: beatra dela sage perite dechaspa.
Tanu rabbanan: "dehav" – en pachot middinar dehav. "dehav dinarin" vedinarin dehav" – en pachot mishshene dinarin dehav. "dehav bedinarin" – en pachot mibbishne dinarin kesef, dehav.
Amar mar: "dehav" – en pachot middinar dehav. ema nesacha! amar rabbi elazar: dichtav "matbea".

a: Veema perite! perite dedahava la avdi inashe.
"Zahav bedinarin" – en pachot mibbishne dinarin kesef, zahav. veema dahava pericha bitre dinare dahava kaamar! amar abbaye: yad baal hashshetar al hattachtona.
Resha dekatane: "kesef bedinarin" – en pachot mishshene dinarin zahav, kesef; ammay? ema kaspa – nesacha bitre dinare kaspa kaamar!
Amar rav ashe: resha dichtav "dinare", sefa dichtav "dinarin".
Umena temra deshane ben "dinare" ledinarin"?

Detanya: haishsha shehayu aleha sefek chamesh ledot; sefek chamesh zivot – mevia korban echad veochelet bizvachim, veen hashshear aleha chova. hayu aleha chamesh ledot vaddaot; chamesh zivot vaddaot – mevia korban echad veochelet bizvachim, vehashshear aleha chova.

Maase veamdu kinnim birushalayim bedinre zahav, amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: hammaon hazze! im alin hallayla ad sheyyehu bedinarin. nichnas levet din velimmed: haishsha shehayu aleha chamesh ledot vaddaot; chamesh zivot vaddaot – mevia korban echad veochelet bizvachim, veen hashshear aleha chova.
b: Veamdu kinnin bo bayyom berivatayim.
Katuv millemala vechulei. tanu rabbanan: yilmad hattachton min haelyon – beot achat; aval lo bishte otiyyot –
Kegon "chanan" mechanani" veanan" meanani".
May shena shete otiyyot dela – dilma mitreme shem ben arba otiyyot, vehave leh palgeh dishma; i hachi, ot achat name – dilma mitreme shem ben shete otiyyot, vehave leh palgeh dishma!
Ella shete otiyyot hayeynu tama – dilma mitreme shem ben shalosh otiyyot, vehave leh rubba dishma.
Amar rav pappa: peshita li – "sefel" millemala vekefel" millematta – hakkol holech achar hattachton.
Bae rav pappa: "kefel" millemala vesefel" millematta, may – mi chayyshinan lizvuv, o la? teku.
